known_clauses.name: pipeline_stage_and_trip
known_clauses.note: A deeper pipeline than the trip count is retained: guarded prologue/body/epilogue provide no general stage<=trip legality rule.

known_clauses.name: cuda_threads
known_clauses.rule: 0 < threads <= 1024 and threads % 32 == 0; optional explicit device limit
known_clauses.source: CUDA warp size and per-block thread limit; tilelang/cuda/hardware.py device fields

known_clauses.name: stock_cuda_gemm_atom_when_target_known
known_clauses.note: Only local GEMM tile extents and warps are constrained; global M/N/K/reduction tails are not required to be divisible.

known_clauses.name: necessary_shared_memory_lower_bound
known_clauses.rule: lower_bound <= explicit usable limit, only when that limit is supplied
known_clauses.source: T.alloc_shared declarations and simultaneous GEMM operand liveness; unversioned bytes are a lower bound on versioned storage.

constraints.policy: Only an explicit Z3 UNSAT verdict prunes; SAT and unknown are retained. Compiler failures are never inputs to the builder.

unknown.name: full_shared_memory
unknown.reason: Exact post-lowering bytes additionally depend on pipeline stage/order liveness, shared-memory reuse, alignment/padding, barriers, target and pass configs.

unknown.name: register_usage
unknown.reason: No reliable static register formula is available; no register-based pruning is attempted.

unknown.name: target_specific_gemm_instruction_and_atom
unknown.reason: Target auto/unspecified or unsupported by the conservative selector; no atom-based pruning is attempted.

conditional_fallbacks: config.registers_per_thread missing: register occupancy limit is one CTA/SM
flash_attention_fwd causal=True: full-KV upper-bound work per CTA
GDN fixed-warp roles: conservative serial source-phase composition
GDN forward shared aliases: source-lifetime estimate, not compiled allocation
GDN fragment traffic is counted without inventing a register-file bandwidth time
GDN group-reduce fragment capacity is a logical lower bound, not a ptxas allocation
GDN reverse cumsum includes the TileLang kernel; torch.zeros_like fill and varlen tail zeroing are outside the dense scope

formula.occupancy: min(thread, warp, register, shared, CTA-slot limits); unknown registers give register limit 1
formula.stage_overlap: stages=1: sum(compute+cuda+sfu, global_path, shared); stages>=2: max(...)

limits: Use for deterministic candidate ordering, not a claim of absolute measured latency.
Calibration must be isolated from candidate/timing shapes; no per-config fitted constants are used.
SM120 uses mma.sync-style FP16/BF16/TF32 throughput, not Hopper WGMMA or Blackwell TCGEN05 rates.
GDN models chunk32/K=DV128 fixed producer/S/V/O or K/A/S roles, not a generic warp assignment.
cp.async uses warp issue counts; TMA uses descriptors plus mbarrier phases; logical bytes stay distinct.
Tail predication, cache replacement, bank conflicts, instruction mix, register allocation granularity and tail waves are approximate.
cost_model.purpose: candidate ranking; predicted absolute milliseconds are unvalidated without isolated measurements

reference: frozen operator module independent FP32 reference
reference_timing: stock Profiler.do_bench(ref_prog), separate from candidate do_bench
